value.rationale: The claim fully resolves a named open question in a recent number-theory paper rather than treating an arbitrary finite slice. It closes the only parity case omitted from the authors' period-equality corollary for \(q=-1\), and the exact \(2\)-adic lemma explains why the computational pattern persists despite the failure of the earlier coprimality criterion. The result is structural and all-parameter, with a reusable local obstruction for entry-point existence.
